mission_08: Combining multiple augmentation techniques in a pipeline can produce more diverse and robust training data than any single method alone. In this mission, you will build a two-stage augmentation pipeline: first applying SMOTE to address class imbalance, then applying mixup to create interpolated samples that improve generalization. This combination leverages the strengths of both techniques: SMOTE ensures balanced class representation, while mixup provides smooth decision boundaries and regularization. Building augmentation pipelines is a common practice in production ML systems where data quality and quantity directly impact model performance.
